newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy cabinet to meet on Albania refugee crisis.
newsitem.headline: Italy cabinet to meet on Albania refugee crisis.

text.p: Italy's cabinet will meet on Wednesday to discuss how to cope with an influx of refugees streaming across the Adriatic to escape unrest in Albania, a government statement said on Tuesday.
It said Prime Minister Romano Prodi's centre-left cabinet would gather at 8.15 a.m. (0715 GMT).
More than 8,000 people have arrived in five days and concern is growing that Italy could be facing a fresh wave of illegal immigration and crime rather than a genuine refugee crisis.
Italy faced a crisis in 1991 when some 40,000 Albanians commandeered rusting freighters and flooded across the Adriatic after the collapse of 45 years of Stalinist rule.
It has since grappled with continuing problems of illegal Albanian immigrants and drugs and arms-smuggling.
Prodi's government says it will grant temporary sanctuary only to genuine refugees fleeing the armed chaos that has swept Albania in the wake of failed get-rich-quick investment schemes.
